data.location: 4205 Hacks Cross Rd, Suite 111, Memphis, TN 38125
data.status: certificate of occupancy issued; opening timeline not presently available
data.short_description: Petra Pastry is preparing to open a second location at 4205 Hacks Cross Road in Memphis, having received a certificate of occupancy on May 20. The 1,400-square-foot space will serve Jordanian-Palestinian desserts, sweets, and coffee. No opening timeline has been announced.

data.location: Diamond District, Richmond, VA (Address not specified)
data.status: construction is on deck to begin in 2027 and to be completed in 2028
data.short_description: Eat Restaurant Partners is bringing an unnamed sports bar concept to a retail building in the Diamond District development next to CarMax Park in Richmond. The building will span 20,000 square feet, with roughly a quarter dedicated to the restaurant. Construction is set to begin in 2027 and be completed in 2028.

data.location: 1800 Presidents St, Suite B, Reston, VA 20190
data.status: aiming to have the restaurant open at some point late this year
data.short_description: Sushi by Bou is opening a new location at the Hyatt Regency in Reston Town Center, as evidenced by a liquor license application. The concept offers omakase dining in a speakeasy-style setting with three distinct tiers. No firm opening date has been announced, but a late-2026 target has been stated.

data.location: 221 SW 1st Ave, CU102, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33301
data.short_description: Piola, an Italian restaurant known for thin-crust pizzas, has filed permit applications to open a Las Olas-area location in Fort Lauderdale. The restaurant's website confirms the location as "coming soon" but no opening date has been announced. Founded in Italy in the 1980s, Piola has had a Miami presence since the 1990s.

Sushi Sake has filed permit applications to open a South Miami location at the former Kiko Sushi site on SW 73rd Street. The restaurant's Instagram confirms it is "opening soon," though no official date has been announced. The South Florida chain, founded in 2009, has more than three dozen locations and is known for fresh sushi and Latin-American-inspired rolls.

data.location: 17315 Collins Ave, Sunny Isles Beach, FL 33160
data.event_type: No qualifying business found — acquisition/ownership change only
data.short_description: South Street Partners has acquired Solé Miami, a 249-key condo hotel managed by Noble House Resorts. The article covers the acquisition and planned upgrades to guest rooms and common areas. No opening or closure event is described.

Finish Your Champagne, an upscale party brunch concept from Hi-Def Hospitality, is preparing to open in Philadelphia's Northern Liberties neighborhood. The venue will feature mimosas, live entertainment, a modern saloon-inspired interior, and an indoor-outdoor feel. No official opening date has been announced, but a late-summer target has been stated.

data.location: 300 South Street, Philadelphia, PA (zip not specified)
data.short_description: Taste Taco Bar is a new concept from Hi-Def Hospitality set to open at 300 South Street in June 2026. It is an offshoot of the group's existing Taste Cheesesteak Bar concept. Mentioned within the Finish Your Champagne article.

data.status: expected to open by the end of the year
data.short_description: Edley's Bar-B-Que is planning to open its 12th location at 330 Franklin Road in Brentwood, taking over a former McAlister's Deli space. The roughly 3,800-square-foot restaurant is expected to bring around 50 jobs to the area. No specific opening date beyond "end of year" has been announced.

data.location: 21003 Mack Ave, Grosse Pointe Woods, MI 48236
data.status: hoping to launch the concept in around 30 days
data.short_description: Little Nest Coffee Roasters is a new neighborhood coffee shop planned for 21003 Mack Avenue in Grosse Pointe Woods. Owner Jason Spencer has been working on the concept for a year and is currently hiring baristas. The café will serve small-batch, in-house-roasted coffee including lattes and teas, with no food menu planned initially.

data.location: 3747 S Las Vegas Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89109
data.short_description: Netflix House, a permanent entertainment and dining complex, is under construction at the BLVD Las Vegas mixed-use complex on the Las Vegas Strip. Spanning over 100,000 square feet, the venue will feature themed experiences based on popular Netflix shows, rotating attractions, VR/escape rooms, themed dining, and a merchandise shop. A specific opening date has not been confirmed.

Chubby Cattle BBQ, an LA-based chain known for all-you-can-eat wagyu beef and robot servers, is preparing to open its first Sacramento-area location in Roseville at the former Tahoe Joe's site. The 7,100-square-foot space will undergo a full renovation. Hiring has not yet begun.

data.status: should open by this fall, at the latest winter
data.short_description: Brassica, an Ohio-based Mediterranean fast-casual chain, is opening its second Greater Houston location in Sugar Land's Lake Pointe Village. A permit has been filed for a $950,000 construction project expected to start next month and wrap up in early November. The project includes exterior renovations, a patio, full commercial kitchen, and interior dining room.

data.status: expected to open in early summer 2026
data.short_description: Desserts By Clément, a French bakery known for pastries and molded desserts, is planning a new Del Mar location expected to open in early summer 2026. The exact address has not been publicly announced. The new store is expected to closely mirror the existing Pacific Beach flagship.

A Vista location of Desserts By Clément is also in development, with no address or opening date publicly announced. The store is expected to mirror the existing Pacific Beach flagship. No timeline has been provided.

data.location: 626 South Tremont Street, Oceanside, CA (zip not specified)
data.short_description: Matsu, a modern Japanese fine-dining restaurant, is closing its Oceanside location on May 31 and plans to relocate within the city. Chef-owner William Eick is searching for a new space, and farewell dinners are being held in the final weeks of service. The brand will continue operating after relocation, though no reopening timeline has been announced.

data.status: targeting an opening sometime in Summer 2026
data.short_description: Julian Beer Company is preparing to open a second, as-yet-unnamed fast-casual concept in Julian focused on smash burgers, beef tallow fries, and beer. The exact address and official name have not been publicly revealed. The concept has reportedly been in development since summer 2025.

Silk Way Family Restaurant, serving Central Asian and Kazakh cuisine in Queen Village, is closing on June 1 less than a year after opening. The restaurant did not provide a specific reason for the closure. The ownership thanked the community for its support during its short run.

Coastal Tea Cafe is a new tea house and café opening this fall at 27 S Fifth Street in Fernandina Beach. Owner Tonya Blanchford plans to serve rotating tea flavors, locally roasted coffee, and breakfast and lunch items in a cozy atmosphere with a book nook. No official opening date has been confirmed, but October 1 is the stated target.

data.location: 1631 W Craig Rd, Suite 4, North Las Vegas, NV 89032
data.short_description: Pizza Baby, a family-owned pizzeria known for 72-hour fermented dough pizzas, permanently closed its Craig Road location on May 20, 2026, without prior announcement. The closure was announced via Instagram, with the team noting they will continue serving pizza via a trailer. A second location in Centennial Hills had also previously closed within a year of opening.

data.location: 1713 James L Redman Pkwy, Plant City, FL 33563
data.short_description: ANF Gyros & Grill is opening its ninth location in Plant City at 1713 James L Redman Parkway. The restaurant, founded in 2009 in Winter Haven, has multiple locations across Central Florida. No opening date has been announced, and the owner was not immediately available for comment.

data.location: 230 W Virginia Street #250, Crystal Lake, IL (zip not specified)
data.short_description: Tatsu Ramen House held its grand opening at its Crystal Lake location on May 26, 2026, marking the brand's second location after its original Elgin spot opened in 2021. The restaurant serves 24-hour-simmered broth ramen bowls and appetizers. Chef Erdene Sainnyambu is also in talks for a future DeKalb location.

data.status: in talks for a new location in DeKalb sometime next year
data.short_description: Chef Erdene Sainnyambu is in talks to open a third Tatsu Ramen House location in DeKalb, which would be the furthest from Chicago the brand has expanded. No address or firm timeline has been announced. The owner is currently going back and forth with multiple properties.

Mama Canela is a new Tex-Mex restaurant opening in Glendora Village, co-owned by Paloma Ramos and her husband. The restaurant will feature an upscale, versatile atmosphere with live music, fajitas, homemade flour tortillas, and craft cocktails. The grand opening on July 31 will include live mariachi music from Mariachi Los Camperos.

data.location: 331 E Atlantic Ave, Delray Beach, FL 33483
data.status: grand opening celebration and ribbon-cutting event on June 6th and 7th, 2026
data.short_description: Chatime, a popular boba tea chain, is opening a new location along Atlantic Avenue in Delray Beach as part of its national franchise expansion. The grand opening on June 6–7 will include free 16oz Premium Boba Milk Tea and a buy-one-get-one promotion. The franchise is owned by Erik Davis and his wife, with plans to add more Florida locations.

Queen & Rook Game Cafe is opening a second Philadelphia location in the Fairmount neighborhood, owned by Edward Garcia and Jeannie Wong. The new space will have a "fantasy future" theme with retro flair and will offer 1,000+ board games, cocktails, and a food menu. An official opening date has not yet been announced.

data.status: aiming to open by late summer or early fall
data.short_description: Scoop of Heaven, a homemade ice cream shop co-owned by Suzanne Pucci and Bill McDaniels, is expanding from its flagship Elgin location to Lexington. Construction recently began on the new storefront, which will feature large windows, indoor and outdoor seating, and a drive-thru. The shop will serve signature specialty flavors and new additions including Mocha Oreo, Mint Moose Tracks, and a vegan Banana Almond Butter option.

Panda Express opened a new location in Goodyear, celebrating with a May 22 ribbon-cutting ceremony attended by Goodyear Chamber of Commerce members. The brand gave free t-shirts to the first 88 guests and donated $1,000 to the Agua Fria Food & Clothing Bank. The new store expands Panda Express's presence in the growing Phoenix metropolitan area.

Guzman y Gomez abruptly closed all eight of its Chicagoland locations on May 22, 2026, marking the brand's exit from the U.S. market. The Australia-based fast-casual Mexican chain had operated in the Chicago area for six years after entering the U.S. in 2020. The company is also facing a lawsuit over claims it failed to provide the required employee notice period.

The Melting Pot is closing its Duluth location on May 31, 2026, ending a 36-year run in the community. The owners are hosting a "Final Dip Celebration Weekend" from May 29–31 featuring a guest memory wall, commemorative keepsakes, and signature fondue offerings. Other chain locations in Roswell, Kennesaw, and Midtown Atlanta will continue operating.

Vilebrequin La Plage has opened atop the UNFRAMED, Autograph Collection hotel in Miami Beach, marking the French swimwear brand's U.S. debut hospitality concept. The rooftop venue is a collaboration between 34th Floor, Schulte F&B Group, and Vilebrequin, offering French-inspired coastal cuisine, a rooftop lounge, and resort-style amenities. It is the fifth global outpost of the luxury dining concept.

Uncle Fluffy opened its second Orange County location on May 23, 2026, at Triangle Square in Costa Mesa. The Japanese cheesecake and dessert cafe is known for its light, jiggly Japanese-style cheesecakes and also offers tarts, macarons, mochi, and specialty drinks. The new store is open daily from 11 a.m. to 8 p.m.

slice/25 is a new rooftop pizza-and-wine concept that debuted on May 21, 2026, atop Grand Hyatt Nashville's rooftop venue lou/na. The restaurant offers artisanal pizzas with curated wine pairings and sweeping downtown Nashville skyline views from the 25th floor. The space is walk-in only and open during lou/na's regular hours.

A new Toastique location is set to open in Johns Creek this summer, operated by husband-and-wife team Steve and Randi Rubin. The menu will feature gourmet toasts, smoothies, superfood bowls, and cold-pressed juices. The location is near schools, fitness studios, and other health-focused businesses.

Mozaika Mezze is a new Mediterranean restaurant coming to Buckhead, brought by local restaurateur Okan Ozyurteri. The menu will feature Turkish, Greek, and Lebanese flavors with small-plate mezze and wood-grilled skewers. No specific address or opening date has been announced.

Bizarre Coffee Company is opening its fourth location in Downtown Acworth, currently under construction. The brand is known for specialty coffee and an eclectic, community-driven atmosphere where cafés double as gathering spaces for local art and events. No opening date was specified.

Phia is a new restaurant helmed by Chef Brad Feickert, set to open at 304 Carroll Street NW in DC's Takoma neighborhood in August 2026. The concept will serve "Appalachian grassroots cuisine," honoring the traditions of mountain life cooking, in the space that previously housed La Mano Coffee Bar. The beverage program, overseen by Dylan Greer, will highlight Appalachian-sourced ingredients.

data.location: Between I-95 and Austin Ridge Road, Stafford County, VA (zip code not specified)
data.short_description: Buc-ee's has received approval from the Stafford County Board of Supervisors to open a new 74,000 sq ft travel center location between I-95 and Austin Ridge Road. The location will feature 120 fuel pumps and over 800 parking spaces, though no opening timeline has been announced. The application had been under review for over two years.

data.location: 5063 Wellington Road, Gainesville, VA (zip code not specified)
data.short_description: Honeygrow, a Philadelphia-founded fast-casual chain known for customizable stir-fries, is preparing to open a new location at 5063 Wellington Road in Gainesville, Virginia. The company website lists the location as "coming soon," but no firm opening date has been confirmed. What Now DC has reached out to management for further details.

data.location: Highland Drive and Nestle Way, Jonesboro, AR (zip code not specified)
data.status: anticipated to open in spring of 2027
data.short_description: The Southern Chef is opening its 8th area location on Highland Drive and Nestle Way next to the Nestle factory in Jonesboro, which will also include a truck stop. The restaurant announced the expansion on social media, emphasizing reinvestment in the community. The new location is anticipated to be open and ready for customers in spring 2027.

Taco Prime, which opened its Bartlett location in September 2024, is expanding to a new location at 5201 Poplar Avenue in Memphis. The May 22 Facebook announcement confirmed the space is "coming soon," though no opening timeline has been provided. The building previously housed a Starbucks and most recently Abner's Famous Chicken.

data.location: 755 W Lee Dr, Baton Rouge, LA 70820
data.short_description: Cook Out, a North Carolina burger chain, is set to open its first Louisiana location at 755 W Lee Dr in Baton Rouge. The property was purchased by a Louisiana corporation affiliated with Cook Out, and a building originally intended for Starbucks is already on site. No opening date has been announced.

data.location: 333 W St Louis Ave, Las Vegas, NV 89102
data.status: plan is to open this August
data.short_description: Lit Wings Express is expanding to operate out of the Lucky 3 Food Co ghost kitchen at 333 W. St. Louis Ave. in Las Vegas, with plans to open in August 2026. The ghost kitchen location will focus primarily on delivery and online ordering to reach more customers across the Valley. The brand, co-founded by brothers Kevin and Alvin Vong in 2021, already operates a North Las Vegas location and a location on Nellis Air Force Base.

data.location: 131 E Katella Ave, Suite 20, Anaheim, CA (zip code not specified)
data.short_description: Burritos La Palma is opening a new location at 131 E Katella Ave, Suite 20 in Anaheim, which will be its sixth California location and third in Orange County. The family-owned restaurant is known for its Zacatecan-style Mexican burritos and has earned a Michelin Bib Gourmand from 2019 to 2023. No opening date or status phrasing was included in the article.

Cici's Pizza is opening a new location at Jones Plaza at 10922 FM 1960 W in Houston, with construction slated to begin in late June and wrap up before the end of September. The nearly 4,000 sq ft location involves an estimated $300,000 construction project led by franchisee group Aulakh Corporation. The chain is known for its unlimited all-you-can-eat pizza, pasta, salad, and dessert buffet.

Fortunate Son will open a second Dallas location featuring New Haven–style pizza with naturally leavened dough baked at high heat. Renovations are expected to begin in June, and construction completion is projected for October 2026. No opening date has been finalized.

Chef Roy Ahn is developing Min's Prime Cut Korean Steakhouse in Dallas’s Bishop Arts District. The concept is shifting from sushi to a premium Korean BBQ steakhouse, with a possible opening in four to five months.

data.location: 8520 Camp Bowie West Blvd, Fort Worth, TX 76116
data.short_description: Don Goyo Mexican bakery is relocating to a new, more visible corner location in Fort Worth, targeting a December 2026 opening pending permits and construction progress.

data.location: 8751 Camp Bowie West Blvd, Fort Worth, TX 76116
data.short_description: The current Don Goyo bakery location will close after the new nearby site opens as part of the relocation plan.

data.location: 290 Dr M.L.K. Jr St N, Suite 100, St. Petersburg, FL 33705
data.short_description: LX Coffee, a mobile coffee catering brand, is opening its first brick-and-mortar café in St. Petersburg after building a local following through events and markets.
Munch Munch Waffles and More is opening its first franchise location in Hutto, offering a scratch-made Southern brunch menu inspired by European waffles.

data.location: 2166 W Busch Blvd, Suite 100, Tampa, FL 33612
data.short_description: Hyphen Caffeto, a café concept by Somos Hyphen, is planned for Tampa. Details remain limited, though social posts suggest an opening “very soon.”
Insomnia Cookies is opening a new Philadelphia-area location near Holy Family University, with a grand opening event including rewards promotions.

data.status: planning to open by end of fall
data.short_description: Town Kitchen, a Halal restaurant concept, is expanding to a second Dearborn location offering mandi chicken, shawarma, burgers, and more.
Hummingbird Bowls, a woman-owned nutrition-focused fast-casual restaurant, is opening in Downtown Skokie serving smoothies, açaí bowls, and light bites.
LongHorn Steakhouse is opening a new Lexington location, expanding its footprint in South Carolina’s Midlands region.
Chef Brian Poe has opened a new POE-Lenta Italian Café location at Hub Hall in Boston, serving fresh pasta, sandwiches, and salads.

data.location: 9785 W Happy Valley Rd, Peoria, AZ 85383
data.short_description: Project LeanNation Lake Pleasant is under construction and aims to open later this summer, offering meal-prep services and nutrition coaching.

data.location: 1810 S Catalina Ave, Redondo Beach, CA 90277
data.short_description: Martha’s restaurant is expanding to Redondo Beach with a second location in Riviera Village, featuring private event spaces and a new executive chef.
Bayroot Bakery is planned for Dearborn and is expected to focus on breakfast items and pastries, potentially serving Lebanese cuisine.
PJ's Coffee is converting a former Starbucks into a new café on Maple Street, bringing the brand back to the area after a previous closure.
Hearsay Social Club is a cocktail lounge opening inside an antique shop in Baton Rouge, featuring inventive cocktails and small plates.
7 Brew is opening a new drive-thru coffee location in Waukegan as part of a growing Chicagoland expansion.

data.location: 2851 E Eastland Center Dr., Suite 5, West Covina, CA 91791
data.short_description: Changan Kitchen is opening its sixth location in West Covina, specializing in Chinese noodle dishes like Dan Dan noodles and spicy beef noodle soup.
Cozy Soup 'n' Burger, a longtime NYC restaurant known for burgers and homemade soups, will permanently close due to rising costs and declining business.

Moniker Coffee has submitted permit documents to the San Diego Department of Environmental Health and Quality for a new downtown San Diego location at 1101 Union Street. No exact opening date has been announced. The new location will expand Moniker Coffee's presence across San Diego County, joining existing locations at Liberty Station, Point Loma, and North Park.

Metro Franchising Commissary LLC has submitted plan review paperwork for a new Dunkin' location at Meadows Village Plaza, a new retail center in Jacksonville. The center is designed to offer flexible space for both local entrepreneurs and national brands. No opening date has been announced.

Gary Williams, owner of Just Jerk Jamaican BBQ in Jacksonville, has submitted paperwork through Williams Estates Group LLC for a new food truck concept called Geewiz Fun House Ice Cream. No location or opening date has been announced, and Williams was not immediately available for comment.

data.location: Multiple locations across Canada (Quebec, Alberta, British Columbia, and others)
data.status: 80 new locations scheduled through 2026; 51 renovations and 14 new restaurants planned in Quebec
data.short_description: Tim Hortons and its Canadian franchise owners are investing $400 million CAD in a nationwide expansion and renovation plan that includes 400 restaurant renovations and 80 new locations through 2026. Quebec is a major focus with 51 renovations and 14 new openings planned. The investment aims to modernize restaurants with updated dining areas, digital ordering, and new kitchen equipment.
